query: How do I apply for Singapore Permanent Residence (PR) and what are the eligibility criteria for PR application?
reference_answer: You may refer to the ICA website for more information on the eligibility criteria for PR application.
answer: To apply for Singapore Permanent Residence (PR), you need to meet the eligibility criteria such as living in Singapore for at least 9 years, having a good character, and passing medical checks. You can apply through the Central Registration System (CRS). [Document 1]
